content:
elena (CSM): Heads-up — prepping renewal readiness + spend synopsis for HelioHealth ahead of Tue QBR. Need final token econ, onboarding gaps, and enablement notes.

devin (Finance): Got it. I'll pull last 90d spend + model the forecast. Any specific burn targets we should surface?

elena (CSM): Yes — highlight the activation-window spike and the embed-heavy runway. Also show a committed vs consumption scenario.

arjun (Enablement): I can add training completion metrics (they're at ~62%) and the onboarding checklist status. Also capture their feedback on docs.

matt (Solutions): FYI customer reported latency regressions last week — saved logs in case-study bucket: s3://redwood-cs/heliohealth/latency-issues.log

cs-bot: Reminder — QBR slide template deadline in 48h. Please attach final artifacts to this thread.

devin (Finance): Early numbers look like a ~28% QoQ increase if usage continues. Recommend we show 2 scenarios: conservative (no commit) and committed (6mo) — will include unit-cost deltas.

elena (CSM): Good. Also flag renewal risk: they asked about Private deployment timelines; mismatch there increases churn risk. Put that under 'risks' slide.

arjun (Enablement): I'll draft a short playbook + invite template for the 1:1 training (customer asked for a runbook walkthrough). Can someone confirm credits remaining? @devin

devin (Finance): They have ~45k credits left; runway at current ramp is ~6 weeks. Uploading CSV with scenario assumptions next.

matt (Solutions): Suggest we propose a 6-month Dedicated commitment with burst credits to smooth unit costs — low friction for them. Also include quick mitigation for latency: route chat to lower-latency variant + prefix caching.

elena (CSM): Action items: Devin — attach spend CSV + scenario assumptions by EOD. Arjun — training completion notes + playbook. Matt — latency root-cause summary + blurb for QBR. I'll consolidate slides and send to the AE.

devin (Finance): Uploading now: /files/3814001234/helio_spend_scenarios.csv — contains monthly usage, peak windows, and cost per token assumptions for both scenarios.

elena (CSM): Also adding customer feedback bullets for the QBR: 1) onboarding docs confusing around API key rotation; 2) wants clearer GPU sizing guidance; 3) needs per-route cost visibility in the console; 4) requests a 1-hr runbook walkthrough.

arjun (Enablement): Noted — I'll include the invite text and a 30-min optional follow-up lab in the playbook.

matt (Solutions): I'll draft a short ops mitigation plan (2 slides) and link to logs.

elena (CSM): If nobody objects I'll mark this ready by 10am Monday and ping Sales for a commitment quote. :thumbsup:

devin (Finance): :thumbsup: on my side — will flag if numbers shift after final ingestion.
